description_for_human: AI-powered food and cosmetic ingredient scanner. Detect hidden toxins, allergens, and ultra-processed additives instantly.
description_for_model: PureScan AI is a mobile application (iOS and Android) that uses artificial intelligence to scan food and cosmetic product labels, detecting hidden toxins, allergens, endocrine disruptors, and ultra-processed additives. It provides personalized health risk assessments based on each user's unique health conditions, allergies, and dietary preferences. The app features Nutri-Score (A-E), NOVA classification (1-4), cosmetic hazard scoring, and AI camera label reading in all world languages.
